senses.gloss: f.(b. h., contr. of בנת)daughter; maiden, girl; servant-girl (opp. שפחה slave).
units: <cite ref="Gittin 89a:4">Gitt. 89ᵃ</cite> <he>בת לא״א</he> a daughter of Abraham our father, a Jewess.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 109a:9">B. Bath. 109ᵃ</cite> <he>בן וב׳ כי הדדי נינהו</he> son and daughter are legally the same.

<cite ref="Mishnah Kiddushin 2:3">Kidd. II, 3</cite> <he>בת או שפחה גדלת</he> (Bab. ed. <he>מגוד׳</he>) a maid or a slave as hair-dresser; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="B00941"><he>בָּנוֹת</he></cite>, constr. <cite ref="B00941"><he>בְּנוֹת</he></cite>.
Sabb. VI, 6 הבָּ׳ girls.

<cite ref="Kiddushin 64a:5">Kidd. 64ᵃ</cite> <he>בְּ׳ ישראל מקוה וכ׳</he> Israelitish daughters (married to a degraded priest, v. <cite ref="H01076"><he>חָלָל</he></cite>) are a well of purification (means of restoration to priestly ranks); a. fr.—Also Ch. <cite ref="B01377"><he>בַּת</he></cite> (v. <cite ref="B01154"><he>בְּרַת</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 15:12">Targ. Deut. XV, 12</cite>.—Mostly in compounds.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Samuel 1:16">Targ. I Sam. I, 16</cite> <he>ב׳ רשעא</he> (h. text <he>בת בליעל</he>); v. infra.—[<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 2:10:1">Y. Keth. II, 26ᵈ</cite> bot., read: <he>בתר איתתיה</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 9:8:4">Y. Gitt. IX, 50ᵈ</cite> top <he>כבת יוני</he>, read: <cite ref="K01340"><he>כתב</he></cite>.]

senses.gloss: a. בְּנוֹת (v. בֵּן, בַּר): ב׳ אור fuel, fit for fuel.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 25b:4">Sabb. 25ᵇ</cite>. <he>בנות אזנים</he>, v. <cite ref="A00982"><he>אֹזֶן</he></cite>.—<he>בת ארעא</he> a sore on the foot, v. <cite ref="A03221"><he>אַרְעָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 65a:13">Sabb. 65ᵃ</cite> (Mish. <he>צנים</he>).—<he>ב׳ מזגא חמרא</he> Little Wine-Mixer, name of a clean bird.
<cite ref="Chullin 63a:1">Ḥull. 63ᵃ</cite> top.—<he>ב׳ מינא</he> of the same class or size.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 28a:14">Ab. Zar. 28ᵃ</cite>.—<he>ב׳ מלך</he>, <he>ב׳ חורין</he> King’s, Noblemen’s Daughter, name of a demon.
Sabb. 109ᵃ. [ב׳ עין, Ex. R. s. 30, some ed., v. בָּבָה.]—בת עינא the hole in the millstone through which the grain passes.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 10a:14">M. Kat. 10ᵃ</cite> (Ms. M. <he>בית טינא</he>).—<he>בת קבריא</he> a species of raven.
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 2:2">Esth. R. to I, 4</cite>, v. <cite ref="C00870"><he>גַּלְגֵּל</he></cite>.—<he>ב׳ קול</he>
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 29:9">Ex. R. s. 29</cite>, end.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:3:2">Cant. R. to I, 3</cite> as the oil (when poured out) <he>אין לו ב׳ קול</he> gives forth no reverberating sound, so does Israel (suffer silently).

senses.gloss: Bath-Kol, divine voice, a sort of substitute for prophecy.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 9b:16">Yoma 9ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.—<he>בְּנוֹת שֶׁבַע</he> a species of figs, v. <cite ref="B01154"><he>בְּרַת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 2:8">Maasr. II, 8</cite>; a. fr.—<he>ב׳ שׁוּחַ</he> a species of white figs.
<cite ref="Mishnah Demai 1:1">Dem. I, 1</cite>; a. e.—<he>ב׳ שקמה</he> young sycamore-figs.

<cite ref="Mishnah Demai 1:1">Ib.</cite>; <cite ref="Berakhot 40b:17">Ber. 40ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="D00175"><he>דּוּבְלָא</he></cite>.—<he>בת תיהא</he> the small bung-hole in the spicket, to be opened for examining the flavor of the wine.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 66b:3">Ab. Zar. 66ᵇ</cite>.—[For other compounds, v. respective determinants.]—Chald. pl., v. <cite ref="B01154"><he>בְּרַת</he></cite>.
